connector.name: Vynix
connector.registryDescription: Give AI coding agents access to your Vynix visual feedback, bug reports, and AI diagnosis.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.vynix.in over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace in.vynix, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VYNIX_API_URL
env.description: Vynix API base URL. Defaults to https://www.vynix.in.

env.name: VYNIX_API_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token generated at https://www.vynix.in/mcp.
